title: Extra-P：可辨識模型與外推保留樣本
titleEn: Extra-P: identifiable performance models and held-out extrapolation
subcategoryTitle: 量測方法與科學成果驗收
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「Extra-P：可辨識模型與外推保留樣本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付參數表、三項貢獻圖、保留樣本預測與殘差；記錄擬合、選模、驗證三個資料角色及可外推範圍。
summaryEn: Investigate Extra-P: identifiable performance models and held-out extrapolation using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver parameter definitions, term-by-term contributions, frozen held-out predictions and residuals. Distinguish fitting, selection and validation roles, and state the range over which the evidence supports a prediction.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Sparse observations can support several competing models. Cache-capacity transitions or algorithm switches may invalidate extrapolation; a near-perfect training fit alone does not distinguish these mechanisms or prove predictive reliability.
